page.overview:
Who is Conche?

Conche is a major character in Final Fantasy Brave Exvius debuting in Season Three as an antagonist and member of the Hollow Keepers.

Conche is a fair-skinned woman with short red hair. She wears a white dress coat with a topaz pauldron on her right shoulder. For combat she wields a black piano adorned with yellow jewels

Conche has an inferiority complex for the other students, namely Cleome. However she has a hardened resolve and is willing help make a world without music.
